apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 181 fixes Metal 4 direct HDR panning stutter by removing queue-wide per-frame barriers and avoiding redundant shared-event waits between consecutive direct HDR submissions on the same renderer queue. Cross-renderer switches remain synchronized. Retains the Mobile Game touch preset, independent control placement, split movement/look surfaces, rim-triggered sprint, Aim + Fire, immersive controls, the ProMotion 120 FPS fix, and Metal 4/MetalFX rendering. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
